logline: A catastrophic tidal wave hits during a high school's ten-year reunion, stranding an all-female group of former classmates on the flooded island campus - and forcing them to survive each other as much as the apocalypse.

pull_quotes.text: Stands out for lightening the tone and providing solid jokes and excellent performances.
A love letter to female friendships exploring womanhood and the aftereffects of high school.

seasons.review_body: Class of '07 landed on Prime Video in March 2023 and earned a perfect 12-critic Rotten Tomatoes score for creator Kacie Anning's confident blend of apocalyptic comedy and female ensemble drama. The premise - a tidal wave strands former classmates on their flooded school's roof during a ten-year reunion - functions as both genre conceit and sharp social observation: the social hierarchies of high school do not dissolve under existential threat, they calcify. Critics praised Emily Browning, Megan Smart, and Caitlin Stasey as the core trio, noting the show's skill at using the survival framework to excavate the emotional wreckage of female friendship and the long afterlife of teenage dynamics. Paste Magazine called it a love letter to female friendships; Decider praised its ability to lighten the tone without deflating the stakes.
